relations.statement: The descent census assigns each named quantum ingredient exactly one status in {Derived, Imported, Conditional, Open}; it is a status map and not a uniqueness theorem.
relations.hypotheses: A fixed finite list of named ingredients is given; no uniqueness conjecture is assumed.

relations.statement: The authority effect text of any census receipt is exactly the string AuthorityEffect: None.
relations.hypotheses: The receipt carries the authority effect text.

lemmas.statement: Census status assignment is a total function from a finite list of ingredients to the four statuses {Derived, Imported, Conditional, Open}.
lemmas.lean_skeleton:
inductive DescentStatus | derived | imported | conditional | open_

def Census (ι : Type) := ι → DescentStatus

lemmas.statement: The census does not imply the uniqueness conjecture; the conjecture remains deferred and open.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem census_not_uniqueness : True := by trivial -- placeholder; conjecture stays open, no statement proved

near_misses.claim: Census shows that only few versions of quantum mechanics descend to the finite obstruction calculus, and no others.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: This is the uniqueness conjecture, which the target keeps open and deferred; the census is a status map only.

near_misses.claim: Continuum surplus is constructed in this census.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Continuum surplus is handed to a later cut and not constructed here.

open_obligations: Ingredient list and per-ingredient status assignments are not given in the source, so none are recorded.
No generators grounded: SRC items are a const, struct, and enum, with no typed operations having colours.
Existing declaration semantics for ProjectionObstructionReceipt, ProjectionTokenError and DeclaredProjectionProblem are not confirmed, so they are not cited.
Uniqueness conjecture deferred; continuum surplus deferred to a later cut.
